sampleReviews.title: Prepared to be disappointed!
sampleReviews.body: This antenna is a joke. 1) Size. The antenna itself, round dome, is no more than 10” across. In antennas, especially Omni-directional, size is everything. 2) Reception. I installed on a home in a Houston suburb on a wave mount w/ 10’ pole, 10.5 miles from 5 2200’ tall broadcast towers. First run I got 114 channels, then it clouded up and reception dropped to 33channels, and when the rain arrived it was down to 7. The indoor flat plastic HDTV Walmart antenna mounted on the back of the TV does a better job w/ reception. By the way, there is no marking on the antenna to ‘Front’ or as a lead point to tune the antenna w/ a starting point. 3) Mounting. Anyone seen a standard 1” mounting pole? Well, you’ll get one w/ this kit. Ridiculously small and not close to any normal antenna mounting pole size. This means something, as the only way this antenna mounts is by slipping over the crappy 1” pole they include. 4) Quality. I’ll be shocked if the whole thing lasts one year. Plastic and wing nuts hold it together. The super-cheap in line amplifier failed in 1 day. 5) Price. My point to this review is that this install was in the best of signal environments and it still struggles and fails. Durability is questionable. Price point is outrageous for the value. This antenna takes some money to get it to work. You get into the install and realize to modify it to work you’re past the point of returning. 6) The Fix. At least in this situation I was able to add a different high quality antenna signal booster to the project and get it working much better. Doesn’t change my opinion of buying this POS antenna, but if you already have - I suggest you get a quality Wineguard or ChannelMaster signal booster and you can boost and stabilize the signal propagation better. You also need more than a 18” 1” pole to get the antenna above ground clutter and descent line of site for the signal.

sampleReviews.title: Great Antenna...Better then ANTOP UFO....Worth the Money!!!
sampleReviews.body: We bought the ANTOP UFO 720°Dual-Omni-Directional Outdoor HDTV Antenna Exclusive Smartpass Amplifier &4G LTE Filter,Enhanced VHF/UHF Reception,Fit Outdoor/RV/Attic on May 7, 2019. We had to continually go up on the roof and re-adjust the antenna as we were no longer getting channels. We did the routine monthly auto scans on our TV to ensure we were getting the most stations. We often had problems getting 3 of the major stations with the ANTOP antenna. The antenna gave out so we replaced it with this Five Star [Newest 2020] HDTV Antenna - 360° Omnidirectional Amplified Outdoor TV Antenna. Absolutely awesome. We are picking up almost twice as many channels getting 64 most of the time. All of them are coming in crystal clear. We did put it on the roof of a two story home. I would recommend this antenna if you want to cut the cable cord and save money.
